thread:
maya: Heads-up: planning a canary focused on concurrency-throttles for the new fallback router. objective = ensure graceful backpressure without client errors.

arjun: 👍 want a short checklist of throttles we can flip remotely. soft (429 retry-after) vs hard (512 immediate fallback).

maya: Proposal: three levels: SOFT=queue+retry (retry-after header), HARD=fallback to compat-model, KILL=block and alert. Defaults to SOFT for first 30m.

ellie: For evaluation signals: monitor 5m rolling concurrency per-host, p99 latency, tcp retransmit spikes, and tenant request burst factor. thresholds doc: `concurrency > 500 && p99 > baseline*1.8 -> escalate`.

liam: How do we map tenants? We should have an opt-in list + VIP-exempt list so paying customers never hit SOFT path. flag payload should support `allowlist` and `exclude_vips`.

maya: Example flag payload (concept): `ff.set router.canary.conc.v1 --payload '{slice_pct:1, max_concurrency:500, fallback:compat-v2, allowlist:[acct-123], exclude_vips:[acct-999]}'`

arjun: Ops automation: add a script `tools/ops/conc_toggle.sh` that calls the feature-flag API and pre-warms fallback models. can we have a fast endpoint? `POST /ops/rollout/conc/{id}/pause` returns 200.

ellie: Also need a short A/B plan: A uses queued retries (client retry recommended), B redirects to compat-model immediately. Measure success by client-visible error rate and end-to-end latency. Use cohort sampling: 50/50 within the slice.

liam: Measurement: compute two metrics every minute for each cohort: client_error_rate, e2e_p95. success = client_error_rate_A <= client_error_rate_B && e2e_p95_A <= e2e_p95_B + 10%. if not, fallback the entire slice.

maya: Rollout steps suggested: 0.5% global (us-west, eu-west) -> 1h bake -> 2% same regions -> 3h bake -> 5% + add asia. manual gate at each step.

arjun: Permissions: only ops+svc-account can trigger KILL. feature-flag UI must surface a reason field for audit.

ellie: Alerts to wire: concurrency_delta > 25% (5m), cohort_divergence (client_error diff > 0.2%), model_mem_pressure > 80%. playbook should map alerts to actions (soft->increase queue size, hard->flip to compat, kill->notify exec).

ops-bot: Canary deploy `router-fallback-2026-03` completed in eu-west at 3791234550 :white_check_mark:

maya: I'll add the form + partner contact spreadsheet. tagging @arjun @ellie for dashboard links.

ellie: I'll add the cohort metric queries to the alerts dashboard and include example SQL.
